title: Bernoulli's tombstone got the wrong spiral
body: Jacob Bernoulli loved the logarithmic spiral, which stays self-similar as it grows, and asked for it with the motto 'though changed, I arise the same'. The stonemason carved an Archimedean spiral instead, whose coils are evenly spaced and not self-similar. Even in death, being misquoted by one's executors is possible.
